help.text:
agentsmd-lazyload {version}
Inject nested AGENTS.md files into Codex's context the first time a tool call touches their folder.

Usage:
  agentsmd-lazyload <command> [options]

Commands:
  hook                    Codex hook entry point (reads hook JSON on stdin; used by hooks.json)
  explain <path> [--json] Show which AGENTS.md files apply to a path and why
  install [--project] [--dry-run]
                          Add the hooks to ~/.codex/hooks.json (or .codex/hooks.json with --project)
  uninstall [--project]   Remove only the hooks added by install
  demo                    Replay 6 sample hook inputs on a throwaway monorepo (practice simulation)

Options:
  --lang en|ko            Output language (default: AGENTSMD_LAZYLOAD_LANG, then LC_ALL/LC_MESSAGES/LANG)
  -h, --help              Show this help
  -v, --version           Show the version

Environment:
  AGENTSMD_LAZYLOAD_DISABLE=1       Make the hook do nothing
  AGENTSMD_LAZYLOAD_EXCLUDE=a,b     Folder names to skip (default: node_modules,.venv,venv,vendor,third_party,.git,dist,build)
  AGENTSMD_LAZYLOAD_STATE_DIR=DIR   Where session state is kept
  CODEX_HOME=DIR                    Codex home (default: ~/.codex)
error.unknown_command: Unknown command: {name}. Run 'agentsmd-lazyload --help' to see the commands.
error.unknown_option: Unknown option: {name}. Run 'agentsmd-lazyload --help' to see the options.
error.explain_missing_path: explain needs a path. Example: agentsmd-lazyload explain packages/web/src/app.ts
error.path_not_found: Path not found: {path}. Check the spelling, or run the command from the project folder.
error.hooks_file: Cannot update {file}: {reason}. Nothing was changed. Fix or remove the file, then run the command again.
explain.root.nomarker: Project root: {root} (no marker found; only this folder is used)
explain.excluded: Excluded: the folder '{name}' is skipped by default, so its AGENTS.md is never injected.
explain.shadowed: shadowed (a higher-priority file in this folder wins)
install.dryrun: Dry run: nothing was written. This is what install would do:
install.absolute: agentsmd-lazyload is not on PATH, so hooks.json points to this installation by absolute path. Run install again if you move or upgrade it.
install.trust: Next: start Codex, open /hooks, then review and trust the new hooks. Hooks do nothing until they are trusted.
uninstall.stale: {count} of them pointed at a cli.js that no longer exists.
uninstall.none: No agentsmd-lazyload handlers found in {file}; nothing to remove.
demo.header: agentsmd-lazyload demo - practice simulation: replays the hook inputs Codex would send; no model is involved.
demo.repo: Example monorepo: {path} (root marker: .hg, so nothing touches git)
demo.startup: Codex loads only the startup chain by itself: {files}
demo.s1.title: apply_patch edits packages/api/src/h.ts
demo.s1.why: First touch of packages/api: its AGENTS.md was not in context yet, so it is injected.
demo.s2.title: apply_patch edits packages/api/src/h.ts again
demo.s2.why: Same folder, file unchanged: nothing new to add, so the hook stays silent.
demo.s3.title: Bash: cd packages/web && cat src/app.ts
demo.s3.why: AGENTS.override.md wins over AGENTS.md in the same folder, exactly like Codex's startup chain.
demo.s4.title: MCP read_file on packages/legacy/src/old.ts
demo.s4.why: packages/legacy has its own root marker (a nested repo), so its chain starts there and the root file is not repeated.
demo.s5.title: Bash: cat node_modules/dep/AGENTS.md
demo.s5.why: Dependency folders are skipped by default: a package must not be able to inject instructions.
demo.s6.title: SessionStart after a context compaction
demo.s6.why: Compaction can summarize injected text away, so every file injected so far is put back.
